name: Spicy Roasted Potato Bowl with Bacon, Celery & Blue Cheese Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg new potatoes
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 red bell peppers
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Quarter new potatoes. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Add to the baking sheets with the potato.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the baking sheets. (Set remaining green onions aside for serving.)
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers; add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with hot sauce and oil, then season with salt. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup hot sauce
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until veggies are fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the bacon is cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Set aside for serving.
Place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk dressing until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add blue cheese to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide roasted veggies between bowls. Top with celery, reserved green onions, dressing, hot sauce, and crispy bacon. Enjoy!
